name: Desqueeze

name: RAW monitoring
summary: en: RAW monitoring for CinemaDNG 12-bit: a RAW row in the COLOR menu makes the LCD show what will be recorded — recording gain in standby, sensor saturation as white, two latitude curves (SA/GA). The recorded RAW is not changed. Test build; ordinary card and Fast Start 2.

name: Open Gate formats (res-custom)
summary: en: Open Gate formats in one: OG2K, OG3K, OG3.5K, OG4K and S16 as extra movie resolutions in Settings and Quick Set, each a small data file in fpSup\RESCUS; the camera's own tables are not changed. Test.

name: Screen flip
summary: en: Flip the rear screen 180°, mirror it, or both — set separately for each custom display mode, applied when you switch into that mode. Test build.

name: Tap to Zoom
summary: en: Tap to Zoom: tap the screen to zoom the live picture 2x around that point; the next tap returns to the full frame. While zoomed, the command dials pick 2x, 4x or 8x and never touch exposure. Works while recording; the file is unchanged. Stacks on Desqueeze. Test.

name: Unlocked Writer
summary: en: Writes recording data to the SD card or SSD without holding the file-system lock, so file-system work and the card write run at the same time. SD card: on by itself (Video Speed Class and CMD20 are detected). SSD: works only with Write Mode turned on. Test build.
